The Scars of the Wounds shown to the Disciples

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

The scars of the wounds which the Lord showed to the strengthening of His disciples’ faith.—J
OHN
 
XX.
 20
.
T
HY
 love these eyes did open;
They’re watching for us still:
These eyes, of love the token,
Our faith with love do fill.
